title: Microloan program and Bleams Road improvements
subtitle: Closed session on property and development charges, and a remembrance day statement on violence against women.
overview: The Planning and Works Committee recommended a one-time contribution of up to $250,000 for a new Microloan program for small businesses in Waterloo Region {{vote:m3}}. The money would come from the Strategic Investments for Business Supports Fund. Staff would also be authorized to sign agreements with the federal government and two local small-business organizations. Wellington-Waterloo Community Futures Development Corporation would run the program, including taking applications, paying out funds and overseeing repayments.

The committee also recommended approving the preferred design for Bleams Road (Regional Road #56) between Fischer-Hallman Road and Trussler Road {{vote:m4}}. Staff would file the Notice of Completion for the Class Environmental Assessment and put the study report on the public record for 30 days, so residents and property owners can review it. Staff said the design is conceptual and that features such as tree planting and benches are still being considered. Staff will follow up with the committee on a property owner's concern about the proposed centre median.

Before the open session, the committee met in closed session on matters including security of Regional property, legal advice and land acquisition. The Chair also marked the national day of remembrance and action on violence against women. Council still has to adopt or change these recommendations.

decisions.detail: The committee recommended a one-time contribution of up to $250,000 from the Strategic Investments for Business Supports Fund for a new small business Microloan program {{vote:m3}}.

The committee recommended authorizing the Commissioner to sign agreements with the Government of Canada, Wellington-Waterloo Community Futures Development Corporation and Waterloo Region Small Business Centre, on terms satisfactory to the Regional Solicitor.
The committee recommended approving the preferred design for Bleams Road improvements from just west of Fischer-Hallman Road to Trussler Road {{vote:m4}}.
The committee recommended directing staff to file the Notice of Completion and place the Environmental Study Report on the public record for 30 days.
